# Every report reads the same artifacts. The unit JSON is what the rollup
# and the graphs need: they are written in terms of the callers it records.
exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_layered.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_layered.ptx -format table $TESTDATA/fused_layered.json
stdout 'kernels.go:45'

exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_layered.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_layered.ptx -format listing $TESTDATA/fused_layered.json
stdout 'MUFU'

exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_layered.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_layered.ptx -format rollup $TESTDATA/fused_layered.json
stdout 'CUM'
stdout 'main.activate'

exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_layered.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_layered.ptx -format digraph $TESTDATA/fused_layered.json
stdout 'main.activate kernels.go:45'

exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_layered.sass -ptx $TESTDATA/fused_layered.ptx -format dot $TESTDATA/fused_layered.json
stdout 'digraph'
stdout '"kernels.go:45" -> '

! exec cudalineinfo -sass $TESTDATA/fused_layered.sass -format csv $TESTDATA/fused_layered.json
stderr 'unknown format'
